HETEROGENEOUS-FLEET CHARACTERIZATION, phase 2 of 2: HELD-OUT EVAL. Apr 6 15:05-15:35 at time_scale=2.0 -- the paper's eval window and load point, directly comparable to the homogeneous H100 run in results/analysis/h100tuned_eval_ts2_summary.json.

Deploy-and-freeze. The hyperparameters below are PLACEHOLDERS: the tune->eval chain overwrites them with the 3D weights learned on Apr 5 (rtt_weight, queue_weight, prefill_rate). If hyperparameters_at_decision shows 0.5 / 0.1 / 1.0, the patch did not take and the run is invalid.

The reference pin (us-west4 H100 at prefill_rate=1.0) and the measured queue_rate normalization both persist on the reused proxy -- merge_update(replace=False) preserves per_target when the chain posts flat learned defaults. They are re-declared here only so a mid-eval proxy respawn can restore them.

VERIFY: in the eval per-request log, hp_prefill_rate must be 1.0 on every us-west4 row and equal to the learned ratio on every eu-frankfurt-1 row. Constant across all rows means the pin was lost and the ratio went fleet-wide, silently collapsing this to a rescaled 2D run.

Label must match tune_apr5_hetero.json's or the chain cannot find the fleet.
